turns.question: Which channel got us leads most cheaply in September 2026, and what did each lead cost?
turns.answer: Email got leads most cheaply in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) at 37.50 EUR per lead (search was 42.07 EUR and social 52.50 EUR). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: And which channel's leads were the most expensive, at what price?
turns.answer: Social had the most expensive leads in September 2026 (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30) at 52.50 EUR per lead. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
